title: Free modules
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $F$ an $R$-module. A *basis* of $F$ is a family $(e_i)_{i\in I}$ of elements of $F$ such that every $x\in F$ can be written in exactly one way as a finite $R$-linear combination $x=\sum_{i\in I}a_ie_i$ ($a_i\in R$, almost all $a_i=0$); equivalently the $R$-linear map $\bigoplus_{i\in I}R\to F$, $(a_i)_i\mapsto\sum_ia_ie_i$, is an isomorphism. $F$ is *free* if it has a basis (indexed by some set $I$, possibly infinite or empty).
